title: Validation of an ecological interface for healthcare professionals for assessing cardiovascular disease risk
summary: The study examines how healthcare professionals' understanding of cardiovascular disease risk changes when risk information is presented in different formats (a new visualization-based interface, a standard online risk calculator, or a written mock clinical report). It assesses how well participants identify the most important risk factors.
conditions: Various cardiovascular diseases and participants’ understanding of them are examined.

interventions.name: To answer five case vignettes, participants will be provided with an interface developed according to principles of ecological interface design, which displays information about cardiovascular disease risk and the composition of that risk for each respective case.
To answer five case vignettes, participants will be provided with a standard interface that displays information about cardiovascular disease risk for each respective case.
To answer five case vignettes, participants will be provided with a laboratory report that includes the parameters used to determine the individual cardiovascular disease risk.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Fluent in English
-  Students with medical or healthcare background (e.g., medicine students, nursing students, etc.)
Exclusion criteria:
- Not fluent in English
- Not enrolled in a relevant degree program
